metaTitle: Custom Biodegradable Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order eco-friendly custom biodegradable lanyards and badges for your event or team. Sustainable materials, bulk pricing. Shop now at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Choosing biodegradable lanyards and badges means your branded credentials won't linger in landfills for centuries. Made from compostable materials like PLA or organic cotton, these eco-friendly accessories are ideal for trade shows, corporate events, or employee IDs where sustainability matters. They offer the same durability and print clarity as standard options, with the added benefit of being kind to the planet. Customize with your logo using screen printing or dye sublimation for a professional finish that aligns with your green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom biodegradable lanyards and badges with eco-friendly materials and printed logos
